title: Paper Boats
subject: English
summary: “Paper Boats” is a beautiful poem written by Rabindranath Tagore. It is about a little child who makes paper boats and floats them down a stream. The child writes his name and the name of his village on the boats, hoping that someone in a distant land will find them. He fills the boats with flowers and imagines that they will reach unknown places. At night, he dreams that his paper boats are travelling under the stars. The poem expresses a child's imagination, innocence, curiosity and love for nature. It teaches us that dreams and imagination make childhood beautiful and joyful.
